_meta.note: Synthetic dossier. Brazilian (non-EU) national relocating to Portugal on a long-term assignment, entering on a residence visa obtained abroad. Route DECIDED by Romain 2026-07-01: Lei n.º 23/2007 art. 88.º n.º 1 (residence permit for subordinate professional activity, WITH residence visa) — NOT the visa-exempt n.º 2, Blue Card, or CPLP route. Sub-article n.º 1 corroborated by AIMA; DL 37-A/2024 (3 Jun 2024) revoked art. 88 n.º 2/n.º 6 (manifestação de interesse), leaving n.º 1 as the standard route. Version tag :2024 reflects the consolidated text as amended through DL 37-A/2024 and Lei 40/2024.
